title: MBL Utils
body:
MBL Utils is a feature-rich client mod for the MBL Minecraft Baseball server, which greatly enhances ball rendering, fan customization, and cosmetics, while improving the overall experience of playing on the server. It integrates seamlessly with your existing mod setup without changing anything outside of the MBL experience.  

# ⚾ Features  
MBL Utils brings a range of improvements exclusively designed for the MBL server experience:  

Improved Ball Rendering — Balls are rendered with greater accuracy and smoothness, making it easier to track pitches and hits in real time.  
Fan Customization — Personalize your appearance in the stands with a wide range of fan options, from team colors to crowd accessories.  
Better Cosmetics — Show off your style on the field and in the dugout with an expanded set of cosmetic options tied to your MBL profile.  


# 🎮 Getting Started  
Once the mod is installed, simply join the MBL server and everything will activate automatically. No complicated setup is required — MBL Utils detects the server environment and enables its features on its own.  
If you want to personalize your experience, open the MBL Utils menu from your in-game settings to browse fan customization and cosmetic options. Changes are saved to your profile and will carry over between sessions.  

# 📦 Installation  
We recommend using Fabric Loader for the simplest and most tested experience. Once your mod loader is installed, drop MBL Utils into your mods folder like any other mod. If you are playing on MBL the launcher provides this mod as well as others in a pre-packaged binary. Refer to https://minecraftbaseball.com for install instructions for that method.  

# 🐛 Reporting Bugs  
Found something broken? Please open a report in our discord and include the version of MBL Utils you are running, a list of your other installed mods, and any relevant crash logs or screenshots. Reports without this information may be difficult to investigate.
